citation.authors: Vinetti G, Micarelli A, Falla M, Randi A, Dal Cappello T, Gatterer H, Brugger H, Strapazzon G, Rauch S
citation.title: Surgical masks and filtering facepiece class 2 respirators (FFP2) have no major physiological effects at rest and during moderate exercise at 3000-m altitude: a randomised controlled trial

population.description: Eight healthy participants, four females (Methods, Participants: 'Eight participants (four females)'; 'no history of systemic disease, normal physical examination'); the four males follow by subtraction. Age 30 +/- 6 years (range 23-40), BMI 23 +/- 3 kg/m2 (range 19-27), weight 71 +/- 10 kg, height 174 +/- 8 cm, all mean +/- SD as printed. Enrolment was in a low-altitude resident group with sedentary occupations (no regular mountaineers).

protocols.name: rest_nx_none
protocols.description: Rest in normoxia (NX: the chamber at 250 m, barometric pressure 744 +/- 3 mmHg, 22.0 +/- 0.2 C, 45 +/- 3% RH; Interventions), no mask (the 'None' row of Table 1, NX rest column). A light meal is printed before the session, with no contents and no time, so no meal is entered and init is norm_center. Posture at rest is not printed. Run-in: the paper allows 5 min of habituation 'to the assigned mask' at rest before the cognitive test (Interventions); it is taken to apply to the no-mask session too, so minutes 0 to 5 are habituation; the battery 'lasting ~10 min' (Interventions, approximate, so duration_min is assumed) is minutes 5 to 15, and the rest values are averaged over the battery (Physiological measurements). The clock hour is not printed: 08:00 assumed.

protocols.name: exercise_nx_none
protocols.description: Cycling for 12 min at 1 W/kg on a cycle ergometer at 60 rpm, in normoxia (chamber at 250 m, 744 mmHg), no mask (the 'None' row of Table 1, NX exercise column); seated on the saddle (saddle height individually adjusted, Interventions). Intensity: 1 W/kg x the group's mean body mass 71 kg (Participants, 71 +/- 10 kg) = 71 W; level = 71 / 186 = 0.3817 (watts rule). Measurements: fR, HR and SpO2 averaged from minute 5:00 to 10:00 of exercise; arterialised capillary lactate drawn between minute 10:00 and 12:00 (Physiological measurements). A light meal before the session is printed with no contents and no time, so no meal is entered and init is norm_center. Rest before cycling is not described: the arm starts at the start of cycling. The clock hour is not printed: 08:00 assumed.

left_out.what: surgical mask and FFP2 sub-rows of Table 1 (fR, HR, SpO2, lactate, pH, gases, ScO2, dyspnoea and discomfort), NX rest and exercise, and the mask effects in Results: a face mask is something worn, which the protocol cannot express
all HH (3000 m simulated hypobaria) cells of Table 1 and Table 2, and the altitude effects in Results: the model has no hypoxia input
resting capillary lactate, NX None rest column (0.8 +/- 0.4 mM, Table 1): a light meal is printed with no contents or time, so the fed state is unknown
PaCO2, PaO2 and SaO2 (arterial gases), NX None rows of Table 1, rest and exercise: the model has no arterial gas series
pH, NX None rows of Table 1, rest and exercise (bicarbonate appears only as P values in Table 2)
visual analogue scale for dyspnoea, NX None rows of Table 1 (rest 0 +/- 0, exercise 3 +/- 6, 0-100 mm scale)
left cerebral frontal oxygenation ScO2 (NIRS), NX None rows of Table 1, rest and exercise

bilateral tympanic temperature TTy, end-exercise values (Table 1, NX None: 36.3 +/- 0.3 left and 35.9 +/- 0.5 right) and the TTy results in text: tympanic is not the core temperature the model carries
cognitive tests (DSST, BART, PVT) at rest, no-mask baseline session: the values are in Supplementary Tables S1 and S2, not in the full text
